change: Command palette ignores composition confirmation and changes pointer selection only on actual movement.
boundary: Original command suite covers drafts, attachments, plugin permissions, errors, theme, zoom and restart. Composition flags and stationary mouse boundary are controlled events; keyboard scrolling and subsequent hover use native automation. First old-build run reproduced IME execution; second run reached layout checks but Escape dismissed a hover hint before the modal. Final observer uses the existing hint-aware Escape helper. Only this observer changed after the successful build. No physical IME, new full-unit, complete desktop or visual parity claim.
